metas.name: ★ 7.0 · 2025 · The Bondsman
metas.description: Resurrected bounty hunter Hub Halloran gets an unexpected second chance at life, love and his nearly forgotten musical career--only to find that his old job now has a demonic new twist.

metas.name: ★ 7.5 · 2026 · Ride or Die
metas.description: Two best friends, Judith and Debbie, discover Judith is secretly an assassin. After a hit goes wrong, they go on the run while being targeted by a mysterious enemy, forcing them to confront the secrets between them.

metas.name: ★ 7.7 · 2025 · Overcompensating
metas.description: Benny, a football player, struggles to accept his sexuality in college, finding himself overcompensating as he tries to appear as something he is not.

metas.name: ★ 6.6 · 2025 · Newtopia
metas.description: A soldier faces a zombie outbreak during military service. His girlfriend, an engineer, navigates zombie-ridden Seoul. Both fight through the undead-infested city, striving to reunite amid the chaos.

metas.name: ★ 6.9 · 2026 · Elle
metas.description: Follows Elle Woods' journey through high school, exploring the formative experiences that mold her into the iconic, confident "Legally Blonde" character.

metas.name: ★ 7.4 · 2025 · Good Boy
metas.description: Olympic medalists join the police force through a special recruitment program, trading medals for badges as they tackle violent crimes and injustices with their athletic skills.

metas.name: ★ 8.0 · 2025 · Last One Laughing: UK
metas.description: Ten top UK comedians face off in Jimmy Carr's challenge: make others laugh while keeping a straight face. They'll try everything to crack their opponents, but must never break themselves.

metas.name: ★ 7.5 · 2025 · Étoile
metas.description: The dancers and artistic staff of two world-renowned ballet companies embark on an ambitious gambit to save their storied institutions by swapping their most talented stars.

metas.name: ★ 7.3 · 2026 · Spring Fever
metas.description: Follows Yun Bom, who, after enduring emotional turmoil in Seoul, moves to the small town of Sinsu to begin anew as an exchange teacher. Initially detached and cold toward everything, she gradually opens her heart after meeting Seo...

metas.name: ★ 8.5 · 2026 · The Office
metas.description: Jerónimo Ponce III, regional manager at Olimpo Soaps, terrorizes his staff, who tolerate his offensive remarks just to get through each day.

metas.name: ★ 7.7 · 2025 · Marry My Husband
metas.description: Misa has been a supporting character all her life, blindly trusting her best friend and husband. When she discovers their affair, the betrayal results in her death. Waking up ten years in the past, Misa vows to become the main character of her own story. She plans to ruin her betrayers by making them marry each other, but after meeting her director at work, starts to consider who she truly is.

metas.name: ★ 6.3 · 2025 · Confidence Queen
metas.description: Confidence Queen tells the story of Yi-rang, a smart woman who becomes the ultimate con artist. She teams up with James and Gu-ho, working as a trio of swindlers, to expose scammers and take their ill-gotten gains.

metas.name: ★ 6.6 · 2025 · Her Majesty
metas.description: Pilar, Princess of Spain and future queen of the country, is a troubled free-spirited party lover who is asked to save Spain of a possible scandal which affects to her family and it could ruin the royal institution.
